title: Rules.
bodyText: The director shall make such rules under chapter 91, not inconsistent with this part as in the judgment of the director are appropriate to carry out this part and for the efficient administration thereof.
bodyHtml: [§378-29]  Rules.  The director shall make such rules under chapter 91, not inconsistent with this part as in the judgment of the director are appropriate to carry out this part and for the efficient administration thereof. [L 1985, c 241, pt of §1]
